_comment: R1a canonical field catalogue (CONNECTION.md section 6). One global table: schemas REFERENCE these keys and declare no private spellings. Spelling is snake_case (D6, ratified 2026-08-21; the academic key is subject, 'course' is 00's prose). Aliases are strings that must NOT become new keys; value-level aliases (U Chicago -> University of Chicago) are P6's values table, never listed here. No numeric thresholds anywhere; every threshold in this product is an injected slot. Every 00_cite below appears verbatim in planning/00-database-agent-product-design.md and was grep-verified before this file was written.
seed: six universal fields + download_session (P6 recorded addition) + the six 00 domain field sentences + section-3.8 role-split fields; nothing further was needed by the R1a roster

fields.role: detected format family of the file; a routing signal, not a meaning
fields.00_cite: a small shared set of universal file facts, such as file type, creation date, language, duplicate family, version family, and sensitivity status
fields.notes: destination_eligible false: 00 says to treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning; no 00 template branches on format

fields.role: filesystem/document creation timestamp of this file version
fields.00_cite: a small shared set of universal file facts, such as file type, creation date, language, duplicate family, version family, and sensitivity status
fields.notes: the time dimension 00's templates actually branch on is the domain field capture_year (photos) or tax_year (finance); filesystem dates are evidence, not folder levels

fields.role: natural language(s) of the file's content
fields.00_cite: a small shared set of universal file facts, such as file type, creation date, language, duplicate family, version family, and sensitivity status

fields.role: membership in a family of byte-identical or perceptually near-identical copies
fields.00_cite: a small shared set of universal file facts, such as file type, creation date, language, duplicate family, version family, and sensitivity status

fields.role: membership in a draft/revision family of one logical document
fields.00_cite: a small shared set of universal file facts, such as file type, creation date, language, duplicate family, version family, and sensitivity status

fields.role: whether the file is sensitivity-protected; the enum's members are P7's to define, never this catalogue's
fields.00_cite: a small shared set of universal file facts, such as file type, creation date, language, duplicate family, version family, and sensitivity status
fields.notes: handling classes are P7's vocabulary (_CONTRACT rule 5); this key records only that the universal fact exists

fields.role: membership in a tightly bounded download session; a purpose clue and review aid only
fields.00_cite: It may be supported more weakly by a tightly bounded download session
fields.notes: P6's one recorded addition to the universal list (CONNECTION.md section 3). Reliability is capped at possible by design: A session should never be treated as proof of topic

fields.role: the institution the holder attends, attended, or teaches at - the person's own school, never the application target
fields.00_cite: Academic files may use school, term, course, instructor, and work type

fields.role: academic term or cycle the material belongs to
fields.00_cite: Academic files may use school, term, course, instructor, and work type
fields.notes: values come only from dedicated term patterns (Spring 2026, AY 2024-25 shapes); no fuzzy date parsing (00 section on narrow date extraction, R6's catalogue)

fields.role: the course or study subject the material belongs to
fields.00_cite: Academic files may use school, term, course, instructor, and work type
fields.notes: D6 ratified: the stored academic key is subject; 'course' is 00's prose for the same concept and survives inside quotations only

fields.role: the person teaching the course; a search/review field, not a folder level
fields.00_cite: Academic files may use school, term, course, instructor, and work type
fields.notes: destination_eligible false: 00's Academic template is school, term, course, work type - instructor is not a dimension, and person-identity collectors are disfavoured: It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension

fields.role: what kind of coursework artifact this is; members are VALUES (syllabus, homework, lecture) discovered at runtime, never roster nodes
fields.00_cite: Academic files may use school, term, course, instructor, and work type

fields.role: the institution an application is addressed TO - never the holder's own school
fields.00_cite: College application files may use target university, application cycle, application document type, and purpose
fields.notes: role split with school: same entity type (a university), different role. See target_school for the section-3.8 spelling tension (NEEDS-JOSEPH in ROSTER.md)

fields.role: the admissions cycle an application belongs to
fields.00_cite: College application files may use target university, application cycle, application document type, and purpose

fields.role: what role a document plays inside an application (essay, transcript, form, portal record); members are values, never roster nodes
fields.00_cite: College application files may use target university, application cycle, application document type, and purpose

fields.role: what the file was FOR, as opposed to what it is about
fields.00_cite: College application files may use target university, application cycle, application document type, and purpose
fields.notes: PR-1 (CONNECTION.md, for NJ-3): purpose stays exactly where 00's sentence puts it - a College-applications field. No per-domain purpose clones may be minted; a purpose-coherent packet outside admissions activates the nearest roster schema on its own evidence or falls through to residual

fields.role: the named project a file belongs to; shared by the research and code schemas (shares_field is derived from this shared reference, never authored)
fields.00_cite: Research files may use project, stage, artifact type, lab, and venue

fields.role: where in its workflow a research artifact sits
fields.00_cite: Research files may use project, stage, artifact type, lab, and venue

fields.role: what kind of artifact this is (manuscript, figure, dataset, notebook, model); shared by the research and code schemas; members are values, never roster nodes
fields.00_cite: Research files may use project, stage, artifact type, lab, and venue

fields.role: the lab or research group the work belongs to
fields.00_cite: Research files may use project, stage, artifact type, lab, and venue

fields.role: the journal, conference, or publication venue an artifact targets or appeared in
fields.00_cite: Research files may use project, stage, artifact type, lab, and venue

fields.role: the financial or record-issuing institution a record belongs to
fields.00_cite: Finance files may use institution, account type, tax year, and record type

fields.role: the kind of account a financial record belongs to
fields.00_cite: Finance files may use institution, account type, tax year, and record type

fields.role: the tax year a financial record belongs to
fields.00_cite: Finance files may use institution, account type, tax year, and record type
fields.notes: year candidates come from explicit patterns only; a bare 4-digit number is never sufficient (00's narrow date rule)

fields.role: what kind of financial record this is (statement, receipt, invoice, policy, claim); members are values, never roster nodes
fields.00_cite: Finance files may use institution, account type, tax year, and record type

fields.role: the year a photo or capture was taken, from capture metadata
fields.00_cite: Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type

fields.role: the named occasion, trip, or gathering a capture or record belongs to
fields.00_cite: Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type
fields.notes: values like Japan Trip 2025 auto-create at runtime (00's values rule); an event value is never a roster node

fields.role: where a capture was taken, resolved from GPS or content
fields.00_cite: Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type
fields.notes: GPS raw values stay local (00 privacy boundaries); only resolved place names may surface

fields.role: people appearing in a capture; a search/privacy field, seeded as not a folder level
fields.00_cite: Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type
fields.notes: seeded destination_eligible false: 00's Photos template is year then event, and person-folders are privacy-loaded. Widening is Joseph's call (ROSTER.md NEEDS-JOSEPH), never a schema's

fields.role: camera make/model/lens metadata; evidence for photo-vs-screenshot, never a folder level
fields.00_cite: Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type

fields.role: what kind of capture this is (photo, screenshot, scan, video); members are values, never roster nodes
fields.00_cite: Photos may use capture year, event, location, people, camera information, and media type

fields.role: the source repository a code file belongs to, from repo markers
fields.00_cite: Code files may use project, repository, programming language, and artifact type

fields.role: the language of a code file; a search field, seeded as not a folder level
fields.00_cite: Code files may use project, repository, programming language, and artifact type
fields.notes: seeded destination_eligible false: 00 treats code projects as structural units whose existing layout is preserved; scattering a project by language would break that. Widening is Joseph's call

fields.role: who authored or produced the file; metadata by design, never a collection point
fields.00_cite: distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school, or our_firm and client
fields.notes: destination_eligible false by 00's own rule: It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension

fields.role: the school a document is addressed to, in section-3.8's own spelling; same entity type as target_university, different provenance sentence
fields.00_cite: distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school, or our_firm and client
fields.notes: seeded because CONNECTION.md section 6 names section-3.8's four role fields in the seed. TENSION: 00 spells the application-target concept both target_school (3.8) and target university (3.11). Recommendation recorded in ROSTER.md NEEDS-JOSEPH: fold target_school into target_university as an alias. Held as a key, unreferenced by any schema, until Joseph answers - folding it silently would be closing an open question

fields.role: the holder's own organization on an engagement; authorship-side identity, never a collection point
fields.00_cite: distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school, or our_firm and client
fields.notes: destination_eligible false for the same reason as authored_by: It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension

fields.role: the counterparty organization an engagement serves - the target side of the our_firm split
fields.00_cite: distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school, or our_firm and client
fields.notes: eligible because 00 places a document's purpose, project, subject, or target above its authorship as the informative basis for placement (section 3.8)
